title: Bathroom Transparent Non-slip Stickers Stair Anti slip Tape Kitchen Wet Floor Surface Waterproof
description:
Bathroom Transparent Non-slip Stickers Stair Anti slip Tape Kitchen Wet Floor Surface Waterproof

Material :EVA acrylic waterproof adhesive
Product color: transparent color
Product quantity :6 pieces/set
Single product size :20 * 2CM
Use: kitchen slipper, bathroom, toilet, bathtub, stairs, swimming pool, floor can be used

Installation procedure:
1. You need to wipe the dry surface with a dry cloth
2. Use a hair dryer to dry the surface to be installed

4. After standing for 12 hours, you can touch the water

(installation tips: clean the ceramic tile surface to be installed before installation, and keep it dry. After installation, please contact water after 12 hours. Rough ceramic tile surface is not suitable for use.

Notes:
Due to the light and screen setting difference, the item's color may be slightly different from the pictures.
Thank you.
